reason: B opens with Peterloo rendered in vivid, specific motion and then moves to Nomonde Calata's testimony and the Talheim grave, so each section is a fresh scene that earns its conceptual point rather than illustrating it after the fact. B's definitional passage is compact and anchored to cases already seen, while A restates the anger/aggression and category distinctions at length; B also closes on a real open question instead of another summary of the same claim.
